notes.title: Final Release, 24 September
notes.notes:
We finally released Rhombus Legends on Steam! 
A lot of work has been done in Early Access stage. Major UI redesign, a lot of new cards, skills rebalancing, PvP Arena and much more. We'll be constantly improving the game in the future, but as all the major functions were realized, we move to release. 
Thank you for you support!

notes.title: New Update, 30 August
notes.notes:
- Added 20 new skills for basic league cards.
- Meet 4 new event cards and "Goblin Brothers" event.
- Bosses on world map now can use golden cards.
- Arena battle replays are available now for watching.
- Changed skill for "Pirate" card. Now it eliminates any spiked card from the battlefield.
- Skills enhanced for "Phoenix", "Angel", "Kong" and "Queen".
- New battlefield for arena, new battlefields for world bosses.
- All Conquest cards were moved to the Rare cards folder in the deck editor.
- Many card skills were fixed and improved.
- Bug fixes and stability improvements.

notes.title: New update, 6 August
notes.notes: A lot of enhancements and bug fixes.

notes.title: New update, 22 July.
notes.notes:
- GUI has been redesigned. All elements have been redrawn to match fantasy style.
- Rewards for ingame activities increased.
- Basic cards upgrade chance increased. 
- Various bug fixes and stability improvements.
